The '''Reyn''' are one of the twelve [[Aiel]] clans. Their clan hold is unknown. They were one of the four clans to cross the [[Dragonwall]] during the [[Aiel War]]. They were led by [[Janduin]], father to [[Rand al'Thor]], during the Aiel War.
